description:
Orchestration layer above kairo-channel: cross-channel delivery routing, session
        directory + pairing, token-stream → edit_message draft consumer, append-only
        gateway-exchange mirror, slash command registry, and a richer platform-adapter
        contract for IM platforms with media/typing/edit/draft semantics. Lets kairo-assistant
        and kairo-code stop reimplementing the same plumbing in every channel runner.
